metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1982 · Koyaanisqatsi
metas.description: A collection of expertly photographed phenomena with no conventional plot. The footage focuses on the relationship between nature, humanity, and technology.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1988 · The Thin Blue Line
metas.description: A film that successfully argued that a man was wrongly convicted for murder by a corrupt justice system in Dallas County, Texas.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1989 · Roger & Me
metas.description: After General Motors closes its factory in Flint, Michigan, eliminating 35,000 jobs, filmmaker Michael Moore undertakes a quixotic quest to interview General Motors' chairman, Roger B. Smith.
